name: MacBook Pro 14-inch, M3 Pro
_note: Generation-representative preset for the 14-inch M3 Pro. memory_gb is null; pin it for a hard assert. Screen size comes from the built-in display (a 3024-wide panel reads as 14-inch), so the sub-class matches even though Apple Silicon does not put screen size in the model identifier. The M3 generation was largely clean; most calibration value is context (the 8 GB base RAM and M3 Pro's 150 GB/s memory bandwidth are spec choices, not defects). See examples/m3-2023/.
